identifiability.missingness_scope: UNKNOWN_OR_NOT_EXTRACTED_UNDER_REVIEWED_BINDINGS; not proof that a parameter is absent everywhere in the original paper

claim_boundaries.uncertainty: No newly source-qualified numerical SD/SE/CI. Do not infer from parenthetical digits.

limitations: Expanded input classes are representational capacity, not improved predictions. UNKNOWN equality does not certify physically equal processes.
Raw precursor wt% does not define harmonized elemental-Li excess without a denominator convention; all 17 normalized values UNKNOWN.
Reported percentages are constant within each source where observed. No training coefficient for a within-source Li-excess response is identifiable.
All 10 heldout dwell times lie outside their fold training ranges; unguarded legacy rank fits are extrapolative diagnostic replay only.
The marginal-range screen is a necessary rejection check, not a calibrated multidimensional applicability domain.
Two historical transfer DOIs are already exposed; neither choices nor labels are blind, and physical-pellet independence and power are unattested.
next_highest_value_action: Obtain one authenticated within-source Li-excess contrast with explicit precursor/denominator, overlapping final dwell support, exact25C TOTAL values and defined uncertainties; the blocked RSC grid is one lead, not required. Freeze source/nominal-formula embargo and decision policies before any new-feature fitting. Do not repeat the same RSC acquisition until actual access changes.
